scope: Public-road tolls for general passenger cars; classification does not mean zero total trip expenses. Parking and facility admission are separate charges.

decisions.reason: AP-7 Circunvalación de Alicante has zero general fare; source node names identify its four former plazas. This does not apply to Alicante–Cartagena.
Both source points are on the departures express parking roadway Irteerak; payment is for parking duration, not a through-road toll.
Source ways are internal Mercamadrid access lanes. The operator describes access, weighing and parking fees; these are not public-road tolls.
Source nodes explicitly identify heavy-goods gantries and link the N-I/A-15 operator tariff. General passenger cars are outside this canon.
The dated Spain extract overlaps the Portuguese Mata de Albergaria access; the point identifies the Portuguese operator and legal source.
T1/T2 express and T4 parking entry/exit lanes of Madrid-Barajas; retained node coordinates and local source context identify the airport parking areas.
Obregón and Cabárceno entrances to the zoo, source area way 177670320. These are admission-ticket controls, not public-road toll plazas.
Retained point on airport parking access way 235094323; Aena describes the general parking ticket and exit barrier.
Road entrances on Paseo de Igueldo and Paseo del Faro. Operator confirms admission is per person and parking during the visit is included.
Entrance road from M-600 to the Valle de Cuelgamuros monument; admission to the site, not a public through-road toll.
One-way entrance and exit roads of Puerto Colon parking; official port services list the car park.
Terminal express parking entry and exit ways 444969324 and 1243693352; operator documents parking barriers and duration-based charging.
Camino de la Warner vehicle entrance to the theme park parking area; parking is a separately sold service.
LZ-602 customers-only approach to Montanas del Fuego; national park guide identifies the barrier as the visitor admission control.
Gantry ways 31983032 and 595891581 are the A-8 at Muskiz, inside the Basurto–El Haya heavy-goods canon. This is not the AP-8 passenger-car toll road.
Entry and exit of the station park-and-ride, accessed from Avenida de los Bomberos. Official station map identifies the car park.
Puente de Poveda approach to the Alto Tajo municipal parking areas. The ordinance establishes a parking service fee; it is not a through-road toll.
Cami de Ses Illetes parking access; official tourism guide identifies vehicle parking fees and separate pedestrian access.
Municipal monument admission control at Monte Santa Trega. The ordinance covers access to the site and museum. Full source extract also confirms this node is not attached to a road way.
Access control to the Plataforma de Gredos car park, on the former AV-931 dead-end access road.
Same retained source way is named Mercadona parking and contains parking facility node 5339323754; a one-way supermarket parking access.
Same one-way service road contains private parking entrance node 11434681631. Exact retained node tags are in access-review-ways.json; not inferred from the nearby hospital name.
Source road Calle Los Volcanes enters the Volcan San Antonio visitor centre; source booth explicitly charges per person. This is admission, not a public through-road toll.
The booth lies inside retained parking area 161870398, Parking Estacion de Abando, operated by Saba/Adif. Live OSM evidence and retrieval hash: access-context/3196925975.json.
Exit lane joins exactly the same endpoints as entrance way 1232649292, whose private parking entrance node is 11434681631. Retained map: access-context/11434681632.osm.
Vehicle access roads within named commercial facility area 246437343 Mercasantander, rather than a public through-road toll. Retained map: access-context/8380303594.osm.

Source incident roads identify BI-3526 at Lemoa Estaziño Auzoa, BI-3543 (former BI-2543) at Dima and BI-3542 at Otxandio. The operator explicitly lists these alternative accesses in its N-240 PPU heavy-goods schedule. Official road catalog establishes the BI-2543/BI-3543 alias; Lemoa plan establishes the BI-3526 Estaziño connection. This is not a passenger-car toll and is not an inference from hgv tags alone.
